summary: Completed testing of contact form bug fixes and admin messages feature. All features working correctly - contact form now uses POST /api/contact instead of mailto:, messages stored in DB, admin dashboard has Messages tab with read/delete functionality, no admin email exposed in frontend, and geolocation iframe detection implemented.
passed_tests: POST /api/contact accepts name, email, message and returns success
POST /api/contact stores message in database (verified via GET /api/admin/messages)
GET /api/admin/messages returns stored contact messages (requires admin auth)
Contact form validation - rejects missing name/email/message and invalid email
Non-admin users cannot access admin messages endpoints (403)
Frontend Contact form does NOT contain any mailto: links
Frontend Contact form does NOT expose admin email (harry.miles@aaasat.co.uk)
Contact form dialog POSTs to /api/contact and shows success toast
Admin dashboard has 5 tabs: Pending Hospitals, Pending Wait Updates, All Hospitals, Users, Messages
Admin Messages tab shows contact messages with 'New' badge for unread
Admin Messages tab has 'Mark Read' button that removes 'New' badge
Admin Messages tab has 'Delete' button that removes message with toast confirmation
Geolocation code detects iframe context (window.self !== window.top)
Geolocation shows appropriate error message for iframe/embedded views
Location dialog shows 'Open in new tab' guidance when in iframe

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all contact form and admin messages features working)
